meta.notes: A fence gate that opens by hand or with redstone; it plays the oak gate sounds, the only gate sounds a fence gate takes. Mined with a stone pickaxe or better, as copper. Bronze Fence Gate: on random ticks it slowly ages into the exposed stage, msm_examples:exposed_bronze_fence_gate, by copper's own chance, and a lower-stage neighbour holds it back. Honeycomb waxes it into msm_examples:waxed_bronze_fence_gate.
